title: Summer opens 15 May
concept: A calm Sado estuary sunset photographed by the generator is the plate; the exact announcement (giant lining-figure date, direct-booking boat-trip seal, CTA) is a typographic code layer in dusk-plum and apricot sampled from the sky.

plate.prompt: Documentary-style travel photograph at dusk over the Sado estuary near Comporta, Portugal. Low wide shot from water level across perfectly calm water; a small traditional wooden fishing boat with a couple seen from behind in the lower right third. Golden-hour apricot to rose sky, top 45% clear for type, bottom 15% calm dark water. 50mm, film grain. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks, no third-party brands or trademarks.
